observations: body L1, L2: the sign above the shadda of «الظُّلْمَانُ» (L1) is the flattened damma; «ظَلْمَانُ» (L2) has a fatḥa on the ẓāʾ, the form contrasted with ẓulmān, and a damma on the final nūn.
body L4, L5: the alif of «الأَرْض» (L4) carries the hamza with a fatḥa; that of «الأسَد» (L5) the hamza alone. The stroke above that hamza is the tail of the rāʾ of «الكُرَة» in L4.

body L5: «ظَهْرُ» before «الدُّبّ» is printed with an elongated join (kashīda), not transcribed; the sign above the shadda of the dāl of «الدُّبّ» is the flattened damma, the bāʾ has the shadda alone.
body L8, L11: «عَجَمِيَّةٌ» (L8) has a fatḥa above the shadda of the yāʾ; «عَجَمٌ» (L11) has fatḥas on the ʿayn and the jīm and the dammatān on the mīm.

body L13: the first digit of «٣٠» has two crests (4.8 points). «Christiano–Latinis» is printed with an en dash (5.4 points). The dots of «شهر...العجمي» are printed spaced on the baseline; transcribed «...».

body L15, L16, L17: the dots of «بدرجة ... وان» (L15) and of «distributorum ...» (L17) are printed spaced; transcribed «...». «فان» (L15) and «العدد» (L16) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed. A small tick above the final dāl of «العدد» (L15) and a speck beside «وان» are not transcribed.
body L16, L17: the letters of the Arabic quotation are «ط م»; the Latin rendering (L17) has «HM». Transcribed as printed.
body L20: «57-58» is printed with a hyphen 4.0 points long, as the hyphens of the page (2.9-3.6 points).
body L21: the hairline of the a of «aequandi» did not print; the letter shows the left side of its bowl and its stem as two strokes. Transcribed as the letter.
body L27, L28, L29, L35: «الحاصة» (L27) is printed without the shadda that «الحاصّة» has in L28, L29 and L35. «الأيَّام» (L27) has the hamza without a vowel and a fatḥa above the shadda of the yāʾ.
body L29: «ζωδιακὴ» is printed without the iota subscript of ζῳδιακή and with a grave on the eta; transcribed as printed.
body L30, L31: «الكلّيّ» (L30) has a shadda on the lām and one on the final yāʾ. The hyphen of «108-137» is printed 1.7 points long in L31, 3.1 points in L30.
body L30, L33: the breathing of «αἱ» (L30) is joined to the iota and opens to the right; «ἁπλῆς» (L33) has the rough breathing, «ἀπογείου» the smooth one.
body L35: the shadda and the fatḥa of «مقوَّم» are cast as one sign (4.3 by 4.0 points).
notes_right L1: «Hist.» is followed by three spaced dots; transcribed «...».
notes_right L2: «p. ii» is printed in small capitals, the «II» of «t. II» in full capitals.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
